property_summary: For every actor and amount, Collect either reverts (leaving balances unchanged) or, on success, only allows withdrawal when the actor's balance is at least MinSum and at least _am; the bug moves the balance decrement after the external call, so a re-entrant caller can observe/withdraw against a stale balance and the post-call balance check fails on the mutated contract.
change_summary: Move the balance decrement to after the external call in Collect.
